title: Steering & Organizing Committee
description: Help plan seminars, identify relevant research conversations, coordinate outreach, and shape program priorities. Membership will be listed once agreed.

title: Research Affiliates & Collaborators
description: Participate in seminar discussions and explore opportunities to improve economic framing, empirical analysis, or causal research design.

title: Faculty Mentors
description: Support student research design, analytical skills, presentation preparation, and professional growth as opportunities arise.

title: Student Research Fellows
description: Contribute to economics-centered research, data tasks, and research presentations through agreed faculty-supervised opportunities.

title: External Advisors & Partners
description: Connect ERS–WVSU with outside researchers, agencies, and organizations for substantive research exchange.
